scope: Four source-informed paired CLI naming/identity engineering controls (eight executions); not new blind chemistry or calibration.
source_binding_status: Execution prohibited until a separate artifact/binary/lock binding is frozen and verified for this candidate or an explicitly reviewed descendant.

expectations.fresh_sealed_vessel: Both variants retain the sealed 1 L headspace throughout; compare retained species against the initial inspect after sealing, including trapped ambient gas.
expectations.canonical_identity: Stock/add operators, relevant events and saved portions use only the canonical key.
expectations.finite_stock: Stock exactly 0.01 mol; first dose consumes 0.0025 mol. The 0.01 mol request reports stock_exhausted with remaining 0.0075 mol and requested 0.01 mol, without changing the inspected vessel.
expectations.pair_equivalence: Compare semantic operators, events and final physical vessel snapshots; ignore only documented nonphysical timestamps/sequence metadata. Never ignore divergent amounts, identities, phases, pressure, boundary or temperature.
expectations.process: Both scripts exit zero, produce complete resolved observations, and do not time out. Process success alone does not satisfy the inventory controls.

limits: Preserve first failures and partial outputs.
CLI bench JSON need not expose the stock ledger; use actual shelf/exhaustion events and retained vessel increments, not an invented stock projection.
A supported alias that parses differently or bypasses a finite bottle fails this engineering contract; do not relabel it a scientific pass.
This candidate does not add new reaction support; original fifty and original normalized forty outcomes remain separate.
